description: Declaration of a direct borrower→lender SPEI that AMORTIZES a loan (non-custodial model, RFC-003, architecture v1.2). Only repayment types — funding lives in its own fundingTransactions table (D13). Borrower declares ('Ya pagué') with clave de rastreo, lender confirms reception; no response escalates to support (D5: the system NEVER auto-confirms money). Confirmation emits a domain event consumed by the Risk Engine (Smart Score) — never inline (D7). Every status change also INSERTs into paymentHistory (D16).

fields.name: intentId
fields.description: Intent this declaration fulfills (D14: every payment is born from an intent).

fields.name: installmentId
fields.description: Installment being paid. NULL for PARTIAL abonos and PAYOFF.

fields.name: paymentType
fields.description: Allowed values: INSTALLMENT, PARTIAL, PAYOFF. FUNDING is forbidden here — it has its own table.

fields.name: amountMXN
fields.description: Declared amount, positive, decimal(18,2), validated vs intent within $1.

fields.name: paymentDate
fields.description: Date the SPEI was sent, between today-30d and today.

fields.name: status
fields.description: Allowed values: PENDING_CONFIRMATION, CONFIRMED, REJECTED, ESCALATED, CANCELLED. Defaults to PENDING_CONFIRMATION.

fields.name: confirmedByClientId
fields.description: WHO confirmed (payee or support actor). Audit-critical.

relationships.notes: Multi-tenant isolation via companyId — injected automatically by stored procedures.
A loan accumulates many repayment declarations.

components.name: LoanPaymentListStep
components.description: IonList newest-first by companyId + loanId: paymentType chip, amountMXN, payer→payee, paymentDate, status chip (PENDING amber / CONFIRMED green / REJECTED red / ESCALATED purple).

hints: CHECK constraint: paymentType IN ('INSTALLMENT','PARTIAL','PAYOFF') — FUNDING must be rejected.

Status machine: PENDING_CONFIRMATION -> CONFIRMED | REJECTED | ESCALATED; ESCALATED -> CONFIRMED | REJECTED (support only); REJECTED -> no further transition here (disputes handle it). Illegal transitions return an error.
Every status change INSERTs into dbo.paymentHistory (subjectType='PAYMENT', subjectId=paymentId, oldStatus, newStatus, actorUserId, reason) in the same transaction.

confirm action: if installmentId is set, update loanInstallments.status='paid' + paidAt in the same transaction, and return loanId, remaining pending installments count, and borrowerUserId/lenderUserId for pushes; when 0 pending remain the caller transitions the loan to paid_off.
Extra action 'escalate_due': PENDING_CONFIRMATION older than @days → ESCALATED.
Indexes: (loanId, status) and (status, declaredAt) for the escalation sweep.
